title: 第4章 极品天赋
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
认清自己练剑进展艰难后，季南北果断放弃尝试，直接盘腿坐了下来。

    “你平常修行，用的是何种功法?“

    季南北出声询问。

    “《仙灵秘典》，并无实体典籍，不过我体内已自行构筑了灵脉循环，你试着内观探查便知。“

    季南北听闻，心中不禁感叹。

    能自成灵脉循环，那至少是六品以上的功法才能具备的效果啊。

    好在季南北已经成功引气入体，不至于连内观之法都不会。

    神识沉入体内，季南北立刻“看“到经脉之中光华流转。心念微动，灵气便依循一条独特的路径自行运转，最终汇入丹田那枚金丹之内。

    而那枚金丹，约莫拳头大小，晶莹圆润，浑然天成，表面还铭刻着一道缥缈的剑形纹路，显得分外契合。

    这就是金丹境修士的丹元啊。

    季南北这般想着，已然进入了修炼状态。

    随后，他便感觉到，以自身为中心，一个庞大的灵气漩涡正在迅速成形。

    四周的天地灵气，宛如受到牵引的潮汐，汹涌澎湃地向他汇聚而来。

    这吸纳灵气的效率，恐怕比他自身修炼时要高出万倍不止。

    一旦沉入修炼，时光便流逝得飞快。

    待季南北再度睁眼，天际的日头已然西沉。此处虽自成空间，但日月轮转的基本法则依旧存在，因此季南北望天大致推测，自己此番修炼至少已过去了五个时辰。

    “你修炼结束啦!“

    察觉到季南北从入定中脱离，萧京溪的语气带着几分雀跃。

    季南北实在不明白这姑娘究竟在兴奋什么。

    望着逐渐暗下的天空，季南北在柔软的草地上仰面躺倒。

    “你不感到害怕吗?“

    “害怕?为什么要害怕呢?“

    少女的声音透着不解。

    “我如今可是掌控着你的身躯，你就不担心再也无法收回身体的控制权吗?“

    季南北心想，但凡是个正常人，都应该会忧虑自己的身体被他人占据吧。

    “还好啦，我在这里既能看见，也能感知到，并不觉得无聊，还能像这样和你交谈，多有意思呀!“

    少女的语调依然欢快。

    季南北无奈地翻了翻眼皮。

    他确实无法理解这姑娘奇特的思维方式。
content_en:
After realizing that he was having a hard time practicing swordsmanship, Ji Nanbei decisively gave up trying and sat down cross-legged.

    "What kind of exercises do you use in your daily practice?"

    Ji Nanbei asked aloud.

    "The "Secret Book of Fairy Spirits" does not have a physical book, but I have built a spiritual circulation in my body. You will know if you try to look inside."

    When Ji Nanbei heard this, he couldn't help but sigh.

    Being able to form a spiritual circulation on its own is an effect that can only be achieved by at least a level 6 or above technique.

    Fortunately, Ji Nanbei has successfully introduced Qi into his body, so he doesn't even know the method of Vipassana.

    As his spiritual consciousness sank into his body, Ji Nanbei immediately "saw" the brilliance flowing through his meridians. With a slight movement of mind, the spiritual energy circulates on its own along a unique path, and finally merges into the golden elixir in Dantian.

    And that golden elixir is about the size of a fist, crystal clear and round, completely natural, with a misty sword-shaped pattern engraved on the surface, which makes it particularly suitable.

    This is the elixir of a monk in the golden elixir realm.

    With Ji Nanbei thinking like this, he had already entered a state of cultivation.

    Then, he felt that with himself as the center, a huge spiritual energy vortex was rapidly taking shape.

    The aura of heaven and earth around him was like a drawn tide, surging towards him.

    The efficiency of absorbing spiritual energy is probably more than ten thousand times higher than that of his own cultivation.

    Once you sink into cultivation, time passes quickly.

    When Ji Nanbei opened his eyes again, the sun in the sky had already set. Although this place is its own space, the basic law of the rotation of the sun and the moon still exists, so Ji Nanbei looked at the sky and roughly guessed that at least five hours had passed since he had been practicing.

    "Your training is over!"

    Sensing that Ji Nanbei had broken away from trance, Xiao Jingxi's tone was filled with excitement.

    Ji Nanbei really didn't understand what this girl was excited about.

    Looking at the darkening sky, Ji Nanbei lay down on his back on the soft grass.

    "Aren't you scared?"

    "Afraid? Why be afraid?"

    The girl's voice was filled with confusion.

    "I am in control of your body now, aren't you worried that you will never be able to take back control of your body again?"

    Ji Nanbei thought to himself that any normal person would worry about his body being occupied by others.

    "Fortunately, I can both see and feel here, so I don't feel bored. I can still talk to you like this. How interesting it is!"

    The girl's tone was still cheerful.

    Ji Nanbei rolled his eyelids helplessly.

    He really couldn't understand this girl's strange way of thinking.
